stops.description: The former Nazi party rally grounds, the Old Town (Altstadt) with medieval streets and bridges; and the Justice Palace, where the Nuremberg Trials were held.
Home to the Festspielhaus, an opera house built originally just for Wagner. On the city's outer edge is the Hermitage, a beautiful park with artificial ruins and water features.
An open-air museum showcasing the local border history and daily life on both sides of the formerly divided German town.
A motel on the highway, perfectly placed for our route.
A Bauhaus Volkshaus - a cultural center built by a social-reform industrialist for his workers.
